newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Nestle Hungary unit sees 97 sales up 30pct.
newsitem.headline: Nestle Hungary unit sees 97 sales up 30pct.

text.p: The Hungarian food processing unit of Switzerland's Nestle plans to boost its sales by 30 percent in 1997 to about 20 billion forints, the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Thursday.
MTI quoted Laszlo Ranky, deputy CEO of the subsidiary Nestle Hungaria Kft as saying that the company's sales totalled some 15 billion forints last year, up by 25 percent from 1995.
Average inflation was 23.6 percent in 1996 and the government expects it to go down to some 18 percent in 1997.
Ranky said that Nestle's export sales totalled three billion forints last year.
